Text: Stretched (elongated) ligaments let the arch drop, giving a {{c1::fallen arch (flat feet)}}.
Back Extra:

Text: The transverse arch index (TAI) from a charcoal footprint is the ratio {{c1::MC / MA}}, measured across the middle of the print.
Back Extra: Why: along the line across the middle of the print, M sits on the medial line, C on the footprint's long axis, and A on the print's inner edge; as the arch sags, A creeps toward M, so MA shrinks and the ratio rises.
